questions.prompt: Which OWASP Top 10 (2021) category covers missing logging and monitoring?

options.text: A09 — Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
It is not in the OWASP Top 10

questions.explanation: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures is A09:2021; without them, attacks go undetected and become long, silent breaches.

questions.prompt: Which events should a security-conscious application log? Select all that apply.

options.text: Creation/deletion of important data and admin changes

questions.explanation: Log authentication, authorization (including denials), and important actions — but never log secrets like passwords or tokens.

questions.prompt: Logs must never contain ____ such as passwords, tokens, or full card numbers.
questions.explanation: Logs are sensitive; recording secrets or excessive personal data turns a helpful log into a new breach.

questions.prompt: Match each concept to its purpose.

pairs.right: Preserves evidence off a host an attacker can wipe
Lets events from many systems line up

questions.explanation: Centralization preserves evidence, clock sync enables correlation, a SIEM correlates and alerts, and ATT&CK maps detection coverage to attacker behavior.

questions.prompt: Order these logged events into the timeline of an account-takeover attempt.

items.text: Many failed logins for one account
A successful login from a new IP
The account's role is changed to admin

questions.explanation: Correlating failures, a success, a privilege change, and exfiltration builds the story a SIEM rule can alert on — none of which any single log proves alone.

questions.prompt: What is 'alert fatigue' and how is it reduced?

options.text: Desensitization from too many low-value alerts; reduce it by tuning and prioritizing
A hardware failure in the SIEM; reduce it by rebooting
Alerts arriving too slowly; reduce it by logging less
Encryption of alerts; reduce it by disabling TLS

questions.explanation: Too many noisy alerts cause analysts to ignore them and miss the real one; tuning out false positives and prioritizing by severity restores signal.
